protocol: Resident MGSI job, parallelism 48, four work nodes; GLEAM 1981-1990 physical index, ten-year spatial queries R1-R8; per-node load sampled every 5 s as in-flight route messages / node route capacity; windowed exact partition access counts; repartitioning policy per manuscript Table 2 (5 s samples, 60 s window, 3 consecutive violations, 60 s cooldown, 0.8/0.2 thresholds, single outstanding action); consistency handoff: admission barrier, drain of in-flight leases, checkpoint, atomic layout pointer publication, epoch broadcast with JVM cache invalidation via clear_epoch, all-route confirmation, reopen under cooldown; shared HDFS payloads are not copied on migration, migration cost counts serialized layout/counter state bytes plus observed checkpoint time; every query verified against the archived golden monthly results.
